LIGHTYEAR environment-first soundscape — 2026-10-13

earth-river-birds.mp3 combines two real CC0 field recordings:

1. rushing river loop.wav — soundofsong
River water over stones in Australia, with faint background birds.
https://freesound.org/people/soundofsong/sounds/641340/
Source downloaded: public high-quality MP3 preview (not the original WAV).
https://cdn.freesound.org/previews/641/641340_9782868-hq.mp3

2. Ambient Bird Sounds — isaiah658
Ambient birds recorded with the creator's camera microphone and cleaned.
https://opengameart.org/content/ambient-bird-sounds
Original attachment: https://opengameart.org/sites/default/files/birds-isaiah658_0.ogg

Both recordings explicitly licensed CC0 1.0:
https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/
The sound pages and licenses were verified on 2026-10-13.
Attribution is optional under CC0 and is provided here and in the sound panel.

Adaptation: mixed the recordings, adjusted their loudness independently,
created a 0.7 second overlap at the loop boundary and encoded a 29.3 second
stereo MP3 at 160 kbps. The mix describes a streamside environment on Earth;
it is not a recording from orbit or a geographically unified field session.

Other scenes: original procedural nonmusical textures in environment-synthesis.js.
Stellar crackle, windlike weather, nebula flow and accretion textures are designed
visual interpretations, not microphone recordings or data sonifications.
No actual measured temperature, brightness, distance or surface terrain data is
converted into frequency or volume. Empty-space scenes are intentionally quiet.

Scientific context:
https://science.nasa.gov/ems/02_anatomy/
https://science.nasa.gov/sun/facts/
https://www.nasa.gov/solar-system/sounds-of-the-sun/
https://www.eso.org/public/news/eso1404/
